_readme: Every explore.cincinnati post lives here. Add one object to `posts` and the map, the home page, the collection and the story/print pages all update. Inside Cincinnati the neighborhood is worked out from lat/lng (data/neighborhoods.geojson); `neighborhood` is only used for places outside the city (e.g. 'Covington, KY'). Dates, coordinates and captions below are SAMPLE values. Leave lat/lng null to keep a spot private ('location to come').

posts.title: When the city floats
posts.alt: Downtown Cincinnati skyline glowing through night fog, reflected in the Ohio River
posts.excerpt: [Caption excerpt — a river inversion, the tower lights, the quiet at Smale at midnight…]

posts.title: The night the bridge disappeared
posts.alt: Roebling Suspension Bridge tower lit amber in thick fog
posts.excerpt: [Caption excerpt — where he parked, what lens, why he waited for the fog to swallow the far tower…]

posts.title: A doorway to somewhere else
posts.alt: A pedestrian tunnel glowing cold blue under a red-haloed streetlight in fog
posts.excerpt: [Caption excerpt — the mural, the sodium light turning the fog red, the tunnel that lights up blue at night…]

posts.title: The concrete lilypads nobody looks up at

posts.excerpt: [Caption excerpt — the 1970s overlook, the architect, why the city almost tore it down…]

posts.title: The reflection was sharper

posts.title: Golden hour, flipped
